cues.en: Next, let's discuss lists in more depth, since we use them a lot.
cues.zh: 接著更深入討論串列，因為我們會經常使用它。

cues.en: If you need to know how many elements are in a list, you can use the built-in len function to get that, like so.
cues.zh: 需要知道串列有多少個元素時，可以像這樣，使用內建的 len 函數。

cues.en: Often you also need to slice lists in certain ways to extract values in a given range within the list.
cues.zh: 你也經常需要用特定方式切片，取出串列中某個範圍的值。

cues.en: The colon is used for this.
cues.zh: 這就要用到冒號。

cues.en: In this first example, we use colon three to ask for the first three elements of the list.
cues.zh: 第一個例子使用 :3，要求取得串列的前三個元素。

cues.en: And similarly, we can use three colon to ask for everything after the third element, like so.
cues.zh: 同樣地，也可以像這樣用 3:，取得第三個元素之後的所有元素。

cues.en: We can also do something like negative two colon, to ask for the last two elements of the list.
cues.zh: 也可以用 -2:，取得串列最後兩個元素。

cues.en: And if you want to append a list to another list, that's what the extend function is for, like this.
cues.zh: 如果想把一個串列接到另一個串列後面，就使用 extend 函數，像這樣。

cues.en: This will add the list containing seven and eight to our original list.
cues.zh: 這會把包含七和八的串列，加入原本的串列。

cues.en: If you want to append a single value to a list, you can use the append function, like so.
cues.zh: 如果只想在串列中加入單一值，可以像這樣使用 append 函數。

cues.en: Another cool thing about Python, is that lists can contain just about any type you want.
cues.zh: Python 另一個很棒的特點，是串列幾乎可以包含任何你想要的型別。

cues.en: You can even make a list of lists.
cues.zh: 甚至可以建立串列組成的串列。

cues.en: So, let's do that right now.
cues.zh: 現在就來試試。

cues.en: We'll make a new list called "Y", and make a new list of lists that contains our newly grown X list, and this new Y list.
cues.zh: 建立名為 Y 的新串列，再建立一個包含剛擴充的 X 串列，以及這個新 Y 串列的串列。

cues.en: To retrieve an element of a list, just use the bracket operator, like this.
cues.zh: 要取得串列元素，只要像這樣使用方括號運算子。

cues.en: Here we're getting back element one of the Y list.
cues.zh: 這裡取得 Y 串列中索引一的元素。

cues.en: This is zero based, so Y one actually gives you back the second element, not the first one.
cues.zh: 索引從零開始，因此 Y[1] 取得的其實是第二個元素，不是第一個。

cues.en: Y zero would give you the first element, which is the number 10 in this example.
cues.zh: Y[0] 才會取得第一個元素，這個例子中是數字 10。

cues.en: Lists also have a built-in sort function you can use to sort the list in place, like so.
cues.zh: 串列也有內建的 sort 函數，可以像這樣，直接在原串列中排序。

cues.en: And if you want to sort in reverse order, you just pass reverse equals true into the sort function.
cues.zh: 如果要反向排序，只要將 reverse=True 傳給 sort 函數。

cues.en: This is also a good time to mention that there are a couple of ways to pass parameters into functions.
cues.zh: 這裡也適合提一下，將參數傳入函數有幾種方式。

cues.en: You can just pass in a list of values, like you would in most languages, but you can also pass them in by name.
cues.zh: 可以像大多數語言一樣，依序傳入一組值，也可以用名稱傳入。

cues.en: Often, Python functions will have a lot of parameters that have default values assigned to them and you just specify the ones you care about by specifying them by name.
cues.zh: Python 函數通常有很多已指定預設值的參數，你只需要用名稱指定自己在意的那些參數。

cues.en: Okay, let's keep going and talk about tuples next. Tuples are a lot like lists, but the main difference is that they are immutable.
cues.zh: 好，繼續介紹 tuple。tuple 很像串列，主要差異是它不可變。

cues.en: Once you create a tuple, you can't change them.
cues.zh: 建立 tuple 後，就無法改變它。

cues.en: They're handy for people doing functional programming or for interfacing with systems like Apache Spark that are developed on functional programming languages.
cues.zh: 對函數式程式設計，或與 Apache Spark 這類以函數式語言開發的系統互動時，它很方便。

cues.en: We'll do that later in the course.
cues.zh: 課程稍後會這麼做。

cues.en: The only real difference is that you enclose tuples with parentheses, instead of square brackets.
cues.zh: 語法上真正的差異，只是 tuple 用圓括號包起來，而不是方括號。

cues.en: So, here's a tuple of the values one, two, and three.
cues.zh: 這是一個包含一、二、三的 tuple。

cues.en: We can use len on it just like we would with the list.
cues.zh: 可以像串列一樣，對它使用 len。

cues.en: You can reference elements in a tuple in the same way that you would in a list, as well.
cues.zh: 也能用與串列相同的方式，存取 tuple 的元素。

cues.en: Again, it's zero based, so Y two gives us back the third element of the list, not the second one.
cues.zh: 同樣從零開始，因此 Y[2] 取得的是第三個元素，不是第二個。

cues.en: You can also make a list of tuples if you so desire.
cues.zh: 如果願意，也可以建立 tuple 組成的串列。

cues.en: Another common use of tuples is in passing around groups of variables that you want to keep together.
cues.zh: tuple 另一個常見用途，是傳遞一組想放在一起的變數。

cues.en: For example, the split function on a string will give you back a bunch of string values extracted from that string, and we can assign those values to elements in a tuple, as a quick way of naming each one.
cues.zh: 例如字串的 split 函數會傳回從字串擷取的多個字串值，我們可以把這些值指定給 tuple 中的元素，快速為每個值取名。

cues.en: Look at this example. We have two numbers separated by a comma, and we know the first value represents an age, and the second an income value.
cues.zh: 看這個例子，兩個數字以逗號分隔，已知第一個代表年齡，第二個代表收入。

cues.en: We can extract them right into variables named age and income, like so.
cues.zh: 可以像這樣，直接將它們擷取到名為 age 與 income 的變數。

cues.en: Moving on.
cues.zh: 繼續。

cues.en: Another useful data structure in Python is the dictionary. In other languages you might know this as a map, or a hash table.
cues.zh: Python 另一個實用的資料結構是字典，在其他語言中，你可能知道它叫做 map 或雜湊表。

cues.en: It's basically a lookup table where you store values associated with some unique set of key values.
cues.zh: 基本上，它是一張查找表，將值與一組唯一的鍵值關聯儲存。

cues.en: It makes more sense with an example.
cues.zh: 看範例會更容易理解。

cues.en: You declare a dictionary using curly brackets, so let's make a dictionary mapping starship names to the names of their captains.
cues.zh: 使用大括號宣告字典，來建立一個把星艦名稱對應到艦長姓名的字典。

cues.en: We'll call this dictionary, "Captains".
cues.zh: 將這個字典命名為 captains。

cues.en: Now to create an entry in the dictionary, we use square brackets to specify a key value that we're interested in assigning.
cues.zh: 要在字典中建立項目，就使用方括號，指定想要賦值的鍵。

cues.en: So to assign the value "Kirk" to the key "Enterprise", we can just say captains Enterprise equals Kirk.
cues.zh: 因此，要把 Kirk 指定給 Enterprise 這個鍵，只要寫 captains['Enterprise'] = 'Kirk'。

cues.en: We do the same for the other starships we know about, then retrieving a dictionary element is done in the same way.
cues.zh: 對其他已知星艦也這樣做，接著用相同方式取得字典元素。

cues.en: Just use square brackets to get back the value you want.
cues.zh: 只要使用方括號，就能取得需要的值。

cues.en: So to get the caption of the USS Voyager, we can do it, like so.
cues.zh: 因此，要取得 USS Voyager 的艦長，可以這樣做。

cues.en: But what happens if you try to retrieve a value for a key that doesn't exist?
cues.zh: 但如果試著取得不存在的鍵所對應的值，會怎樣？

cues.en: You get an exception in that case.
cues.zh: 這時會發生例外。

cues.en: One way to avoid that is to use the get function on the dictionary.
cues.zh: 避免的方法之一，是使用字典的 get 函數。

cues.en: So, you see you can retrieve the captain of the Enterprise successfully, as it exists in the dictionary.
cues.zh: 你看，可以順利取得 Enterprise 的艦長，因為它存在於字典中。

cues.en: But if we try to get a ship that isn't in our dictionary, it returns the special value none that you can test for and deal with however you want.
cues.zh: 但如果查詢字典中沒有的星艦，就會傳回特殊值 None，你可以檢查它，並用任何想要的方式處理。

cues.en: And if you know that the captain of the N-X-O-one is Jonathan Archer, you're my new best friend.
cues.zh: 如果你知道 NX-01 的艦長是 Jonathan Archer，你就是我的新好朋友。

cues.en: You can iterate through all of the keys in the dictionary just you'd iterate through a list like this.
cues.zh: 你可以像走訪串列一樣，走訪字典中的所有鍵。

cues.en: For ship in captains, will give you back each key in the captains dictionary and name its ship for you so we can then print it out, like so.
cues.zh: for ship in captains 會依序取得 captains 字典的每個鍵，將它命名為 ship，然後就可以像這樣印出來。
